Meta Compute: Everyone Wants To Be A Neocloud Meta 的算力：人人都想做 Neocloud
SemiAnalysis · 2026-07-02
Meta Compute: Everyone Wants To Be A Neocloud Meta 的算力：人人都想做 Neocloud
Zuck Takes Plan B? SpaceX 2.0, Bedrock 2.0, MSL Isn’t Giving Up, Scaling RecSys by 10x… ClusterMAX ranking coming soon?
扎克伯格启动 B 计划？SpaceX 2.0、Bedrock 2.0、MSL（Meta Superintelligence Labs，Meta 超级智能实验室）并未放弃、推荐系统扩大 10 倍…… ClusterMAX 排名即将发布？
Jeremie Eliahou Ontiveros, Max Kan, Joey Brookhart, and 2 others — Jul 02, 2026 · SemiAnalysis
Jeremie Eliahou Ontiveros 、 Max Kan 、 Joey Brookhart 等 5 人 —— 2026 年 7 月 2 日 · SemiAnalysis
With Bloomberg headlines suggesting Meta could become a Neocloud, the market’s reaction was immediate: aggressive sell-off of Neoclouds like Coreweave & Nebius, and debates of “overcapacity” coming back. Let’s set the record straight – we believe that both takes are erroneous and that Meta’s datacenter & compute procurement will accelerate, not slow down. Capex in 2027 will be shockingly high. In just the first six months of the year, Meta has contracted over 5GW of capacity across Cloud & Colo, and that doesn’t even include all their accelerating self-build activity. Everything is computer and everything is a neocloud.
彭博社的报道称 Meta 可能转型为 Neocloud，市场的反应立竿见影：Coreweave、Nebius 等 Neocloud 遭到猛烈抛售，“产能过剩”的争论卷土重来。我们把话说清楚——这两种解读都是错的，Meta 的数据中心与算力采购只会加速，不会放缓。2027 年的资本开支将高得惊人。仅今年上半年，Meta 就已在云与托管（colo）两条线上签下超过 5GW 的容量，而这还没算上其自建活动的加速部分。万物皆算力，人人都是neocloud。
[Figure: Meta’s Compute Deals per Quarter (GW of IT Capacity) — over 5GW of cloud & colo contracted in 2026 year-to-date; stacked bars of New Datacenter Leases and New Neocloud GPU Deals, Q3 2025 through Q2 2026. Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Model]
[图：Meta 每季度的算力交易（GW，以 IT 容量计）—— 2026 年至今已签下超过 5GW 的云与 colo 容量；堆叠柱状图分为新增数据中心租约与新增 Neocloud GPU 交易，覆盖 Q3 2025 至 Q2 2026。来源：SemiAnalysis Datacenter Model]
中英对照 / BILINGUAL

Meta’s capacity under construction just keeps accelerating. We show below Meta’s two largest campuses – these two pictures represent 2.5GW of capacity under construction! By the way, if you believed the laughable headlines that “half of US datacenters and delayed and only 5GW are under construction”, we show you here that just two datacenters are half of this. Read our piece “Stop Saying Half of US Datacenters Are Delayed” for more on why these headlines are completely off.
Meta 在建容量的增速还在不断加快。下图是 Meta 最大的两个园区——这两张图代表了 2.5GW 的在建容量！顺带一提，如果你此前相信了那些可笑的标题— “美国一半的数据中心已经延期，在建的只有 5GW”我们在这里告诉你，仅仅两个数据中心就占了其中的一半。想了解这类标题为何完全离谱，请读我们的《Stop Saying Half of US Datacenters Are Delayed》。
[Figure: Satellite imagery of Meta’s two largest campuses under construction. Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Model]
[图：Meta 两个最大在建园区的卫星影像。来源：SemiAnalysis Datacenter Model]
Of course, this naturally raises the questions of what Meta will do with this compute, and whether they’re going to flood the market with all of this supply if they turn into a Neocloud. Broadly speaking we see four major high-value use-cases, which are all differentied and very different relative to what traditional Neoclouds do:
这自然引出了两个问题：Meta 要拿这些算力做什么？如果它真的转型成 Neocloud，会不会把所有供给一股脑倾泻到市场上？大体上，我们看到四类高价值用途，它们彼此差异明显，也与传统 Neocloud 所做的事情大不相同：

1. Frontier AI Models: Meta has NOT given up on training frontier models. The bulk of incremental capacity still goes to Meta Superintelligence Labs, and we think the team is currently excited about their progress. A follow-up report will dive into MSL, their unique data strategy, and discuss their chances of catching up with Anthropic and OpenAI. Of course, our Tokenomics Model subscribers already know our takes and have access to all of this real-time.
2. RecSys: We believe Meta thinks they can scale up Ads recommendation systems by >10x in complexity to accelerate revenue growth. That requires both inference & training compute for their RecSys models. They can also do more generative targeted ads.
3. (SemiAnalysis Exclusive) We believe that Meta is in final talks with Anthropic to get access to private instances of Claude. This would be akin to Bedrock, Foundry, Vertex from other hyperscalers (read our deep dive here). There are multiple use-cases for Meta, ranging from internal usage, to building the premier Sales & Marketing SaaS powered by Frontier AI Agents. We expect Meta to launch a token-asa-service endpoint and increasingly move up the stack, leveraging its network and distribution. Initially it will be their own models externally and Anthropic internaly, but over time we believe they will serve Anthropic and OpenAI models externally
4. We expect Meta to strike a few “SpaceX-type” deals. Elon is a sales genius, and he created a brand new market segment: large-scale on-demand compute at a huge pricing premium. We think Meta wants in, but selectively. After all, just a couple hundred MWs can already drive >\$10B of yearly revenue! We expect a ten billion dollar Anthropic deal to kick off the flywheel.
1. 前沿 AI 模型：Meta 并没有放弃训练前沿模型。新增容量的大头仍然流向 Meta Superintelligence Labs，我们认为团队目前对自身进展感到兴奋。后续报告将深入 MSL、其独特的数据策略，并讨论它追上Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的胜算。当然，我们 Tokenomics Model 的订户早已知道我们的判断，并能实时获取全部内容。
2. 推荐系统（RecSys）：我们认为 Meta 相信自 己可以把广告推荐系统的复杂度放大 10 倍以上，以加速收入增长。这需要为其 RecSys 模型同时投入推理与训练算力。它们还可以做更多生成式定向广告。
3. （SemiAnalysis 独家）我们认为 Meta 正在与 Anthropic 进行最后阶段的谈判，以获得 Claude 的私有实例。这类似于其他 hyperscaler 的 Bedrock、Foundry、Vertex（点此阅读我们的深度分析）。对 Meta 而言用途很多，从内部使用，到打造由前沿 AI Agent 驱动的顶级销售与营销 SaaS。我们预计 Meta 会推出token 即服务（TaaS）的接口，并不断向上层堆栈延伸，借助自身的网络与分发能力。初期大概是对外提供自家模型、对内使用 Anthropic，但长期看，我们认为它会对外提供 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的模型。
4. 我们预计 Meta 会做成几笔“SpaceX 式”的交易。马斯克是销售天才，他创造了一个全新的市场细分：以极高溢价出售的大规模按需算力。我们认为 Meta 想入局，但会有所取舍。毕竟，区区几百 MW 就已经能带来 >\$10B 的年收入！我们预计会有一笔百亿美元级的 Anthropic 交易，为这个飞轮点火。

This high optionality, with four high-value-add options, makes it easy for Meta to keep aggressively contracting compute. Meta Superintelligence remains the core engine, but if it doesn’t work out, there are many high-margin alternatives to sell compute. It is essentially a CFO’s dream and makes it very easy to go all-in on compute – we bet Susan did a 180° flip when she saw the pricing of SpaceX compute deals! Meta won’t be a normal bare-metal IaaS vendor with \~30% gross margins – all its options are high value, and enable to easily afford paying a margin to other Neoclouds in order to accelerate their fleet buildout - even if MSL doesn’t work out.
四条高附加值路径带来的高度可选性，使 Meta 能够毫无负担地继续激进锁定算力。Meta Superintelligence仍是核心引擎，但即便它跑不通，也还有大量高毛利的算力变现路径。这本质上是 CFO 的梦想，让“All-in算力”变成一个极易做出的决定——我们敢打赌，Susan 在看到 SpaceX 算力交易的定价时来了个 180° 大转弯！Meta 不会沦为毛利率 \~30% 的普通裸金属 IaaS 供应商——它的每一个选项都是高价值的，因此完全负担得起向其他 Neocloud 支付一层利润，以换取自身机队的更快铺开——哪怕 MSL 最终没有跑通。
Our Datacenter Model breaks down quarter by quarter their capacity additions across selfbuild, datacenter leasing, and cloud renting. After nearly 10GW of deals signed since early 2024, the bulk of their capacity additions are now through 3rd parties. We expect this to continue and believe that Meta will be a huge source of RPO growth for the likes of Coreweave, Nebius and others.
我们的 Datacenter Model 逐季拆解了 Meta 在自建、数据中心租赁和云租用三条路径上的容量增量。自 2024年初以来签下近 10GW 的交易之后，其容量增量的大头如今来自第三方。我们预计这一趋势将延续，并认为Meta 会成为 Coreweave、Nebius 等公司 RPO（剩余履约义务）增长的巨大来源。
Our model also breaks down, quarter by quarter, Meta’s capacity into MSL, other AI, and non-AI. While MSL’s huge growth is understandable (they need to keep up with Anthropic & OpenAI!), the surge of Other AI in 2026 suggests plenty of optionality to monetize compute across RecSys, “SpaceX equivalent”, and Bedrock-type token as a service. If RecSys scales a bit less than expected, they have other options. Of course, if MSL fails, Cloud capacity will skyrocket.
我们的模型还逐季把 Meta 的容量拆成 MSL、其他 AI 和非 AI 三块。MSL 的高速增长可以理解（它们必须跟上 Anthropic 和 OpenAI！），而 2026 年“其他 AI”的激增说明：在 RecSys、“SpaceX 等价物”和Bedrock 式的 token 即服务之间，Meta 有大把变现算力的余地。即使 RecSys 的扩展略低于预期，它们也还有别的选择。当然，如果 MSL 失败，云容量会直接起飞。
[Figure: Meta’s Total Compute Capacity (GW of IT Capacity), 2023–2027, split into Meta Superintelligence, Other AI, and Non-AI. Source: SemiAnalysis Tokenomics Model, Datacenter Model]
[图：Meta 总算力容量（GW，以 IT 容量计），2023—2027 年，拆分为 Meta Superintelligence、其他 AI 与非 AI。来源：SemiAnalysis Tokenomics Model、Datacenter Model]
下面我们逐一拆解这四个选项。先从类 SpaceX 的交易和 Bedrock 式的野心讲起。随后在付费墙之后，我们讨论 MSL 与 RecSys 的前景。

SpaceX dreams – Elon’s genius deals SpaceX 之梦— 马斯克的天才交易
Elon Musk shocked the AI infrastructure world when he announced the first Anthropic deal. He doubleshocked the world when he came up with the Google deal. The reason is simple: the revenue per MW of these deals are respectively triple and quadruple what peers are charging, as shown below. The profit per MW gap is, of course, even larger given the cost structure is roughly the same.
马斯克宣布第一笔 Anthropic 交易时，震动了整个 AI 基础设施圈。当他拿出 Google 那笔交易时，世界被二度震动。原因很简单：如下图所示，这两笔交易的单 MW 收入分别是同行报价的三倍和四倍。而由于成本结构大致相同，单 MW 利润的差距自然更大。
[图：SpaceX 创造了一个新的市场细分—— 短期＋大规模算力，溢价极高。各玩家的单 GW 年化收入：Neocloud 五年期 IaaS 平均 \$12B（1.0x）、B300 按需 \$29B（2.4x）、SpaceX + Anthropic \$31B（2.6x）、SpaceX + Google \$48B（4.0x）。来源：AI Cloud TCO Model]
SpaceX’s pricing on the Google deal is even higher than what we observe on the on-demand or short-term rental market. Elon essentially invented a new market segment. Our AI Cloud TCO model team tracks hundreds of GPU cloud deals every year, including all contract terms like SLA, pricing, contract length etc. That’s why we have, by far, the world’s best information on GPU pricing by contract length – see a preview in our free dashboard here.
SpaceX 在 Google 这笔交易上的定价，甚至高于我们在按需或短租市场观察到的水平。马斯克实质上发明了一个新的市场细分。我们的 AI Cloud TCO 模型团队每年跟踪数百笔 GPU 云交易，包括 SLA、定价、合约期限等全部合约条款。这也是为什么我们在“按合约期限划分的 GPU 定价”上，拥有全球遥遥领先的最佳数据可在我们的免费看板中先睹为快。
We have never ever seen a deal that large, and that short: the deal is three years, but with option to cancel from both parties within 90 days – so it’s effectively a 3-month deal with automatic renewal.
我们从未见过规模如此之大、期限却如此之短的交易：合约期为三年，但双方均可在 90 天内选择取消——所以它实际上是一份自动续约的三个月合约。

The reason this has never happened is because very few companies can do it. The financing burden excludes all the Neoclouds from participating in that market – for large clusters, they need to secure an offtaker over multiple years. The top 3 hyperscalers could’ve done it… but they all see higher-value longterm options, such as Microsoft getting OpenAI’s IP in exchange for equity investments & compute, Amazon focused on increasing the adoption of Bedrock and Trainium, Google similarly with TPUs and Vertex (now Gemini Enterprise Platform).
之所以从未出现过这种交易，是因为能做的公司极少。融资压力把所有 Neocloud 都挡在了这个市场之外—对于大型集群，它们必须锁定一个跨越数年的承购方。前三大 hyperscaler 本来做得了……但它们都看到了价值更高的长期选项：微软用股权投资和算力换取 OpenAI 的知识产权，亚马逊专注于提升 Bedrock 与Trainium 的采用率，Google 同理，靠的是 TPU 和 Vertex（现更名为 Gemini Enterprise Platform）。
This effectively leaves only two companies that can truly capitalize on this new market: Oracle and Meta. For the former, we see this as a massive blow. It’s yet another piece of evidence that they could’ve done a much better job at monetizing all of their gigawatts of compute. A look at the valuation trajectory of Oracle vs SpaceX illustrates the massive divergence. For both, Gigawatts are an increasing portion of their valuation, and a large driver of that evolution within the last year.
这样一来，真正能吃到这个新市场的其实只剩两家公司：Oracle 和 Meta。对前者而言，我们认为这是一记重击。这再一次证明，它本可以把手里那么多 GW 的算力变现得漂亮得多。对比 Oracle 与 SpaceX 的估值轨迹，就能看出这条巨大的分岔。对两家公司来说，GW 在估值中的占比都在上升，也是过去一年估值演变的主要驱动力。
[Figure: SpaceX vs. Oracle — Valuation, Last 360 Days. SpaceX ×6.1 (\$350B mark → \$2.13T market cap); Oracle -38% (\$652B → \$404B); SpaceX passed Oracle Dec 12, 2025. Source: SemiAnalysis, SEC, CNBC/Bloomberg/Reuters]
[图：SpaceX vs. Oracle— —过去 360 天的估值。SpaceX ×6.1（\$350B 估值 → \$2.13T 市值）；Oracle-38%（\$652B → \$404B）；SpaceX 于 2025 年 12 月 12 日 反超 Oracle。来源：SemiAnalysis、SEC、CNBC/彭博/路透]
Enter Meta. Given their laser-focus on building Superintelligence, they probably didn’t put enough thought into the Cloud option. SpaceX and Elon paved the way for them. At \$50B/Gigawatt of annual revenue, it becomes an easy call. Just allocating 200MW of compute to an external customer drives \$10B/yr of revenue, at sky-high margin. And the ability to cancel that contract within 90 days makes it even easier – if they want to give MSL more compute, they can, in short notice.
轮到 Meta 登场。由于全部心思都扑在构建超级智能上，它们大概没有认真想过云这个选项。SpaceX 和马斯克替它们把路铺好了。在每 GW \$50B 年收入的水平上，这变成一道送分题。仅把 200MW 算力分配给一个外部客户，就能带来 \$10B/年的收入，而且毛利高得离谱。再加上 90 天内即可取消合约的条款，这道题就更好做了——如果它们想把更多算力还给 MSL，随时可以。

That’s also a perfect match for Meta’s datacenter construction strategy. A year ago, we were the first to track their new “tent” ultra-fast datacenter design. Since then, Meta tents have been popping up all over the US! By bringing datacenters online fast, even if “lower quality”, it’ll be easier for Meta to monetize compute in a SpaceX fashion.
这也与 Meta 的数据中心建设策略完美契合。一年前，我们率先追踪到它们全新的“帐篷式”超快数据中心设计。此后，Meta 的帐篷在全美各地冒了出来！让数据中心快速上线，哪怕“品质更低”，也会让 Meta 更容易以 SpaceX 的方式把算力变现。
[Figure: Satellite image of a Meta “tent” datacenter under construction. Source: SemiAnalysis Datacenter Model]
[图：一座在建的 Meta “帐篷式”数据中心的卫星影像。来源：SemiAnalysis Datacenter Model]
As such, we expect Meta to announce such a deal soon. It’s a great way to get the flywheel started.   
Anthropic is our prime suspect, but others could step in as well, such as OpenAI or Google.
因此，我们预计 Meta 很快就会宣布这样一笔交易。这是启动飞轮的绝佳方式。Anthropic 是我们的头号嫌疑人，但其他玩家也可能出手，比如 OpenAI 或 Google。
Will Meta build the new Bedrock?
Meta 会不会造出新的 Bedrock？
Another great option for Meta is to strike a deep partnership with frontier labs to sell their models with Meta’s own compute. As said earlier, we believe they are in final talks with Anthropic to get private access to their LLMs, just like Amazon has through Bedrock (agreement explained in detail here). This means that for Meta, another way to monetize their compute will be to sell Claude. We see three main paths:
Meta 的另一个上佳选项，是与前沿实验室达成深度合作，用 Meta 自 己的算力去销售它们的模型。如前所述，我们认为它们正与 Anthropic 进行最后阶段的谈判，以获得对其 LLM 的私有访问权限，正如亚马逊通过Bedrock 所做的那样（协议细节见此）。这意味着对 Meta 来说，算力变现的另一条路是卖 Claude。我们看到三条主要路径：

1. Part of it could be for internal usage only. Meta needs Claude tokens, and Anthropic can’t keep up with demand. There are also security & privacy layers. In the future, we could see other very large enterprises striking such deals, e.g. a JPMorgan probably won’t go all-in on Claude if they don’t have the security and privacy guarantees that private instances enables (in their own datacenters).
2. Meta could sell Claude as a service in the same way Bedrock does. They have capacity and own the full stack, from CPU to GPU to networking, with high security. However, as a new entrant, it’ll be tough to create all the enterprise relationships that AWS has. But Meta has the option to leverage their customer base of advertisers and better integrate frontier agents and LLMs into their suite, creating a new largescale distribution path.
3. Meta could go even more vertical and start building applications. As one of the world’s largest advertising platforms, they have a path to building a Sales & Marketing powerhouse. Integrating frontier models and agents would increase their odds of building a world class solution.
1. 其中一部分可能仅供内部使用。Meta 需要 Claude 的 token，而 Anthropic 的供给跟不上需求。此外还有安全与隐私层面的考量。未来我们可能会看到其他超大型企业也签下这类协议——比如摩根大通，如果拿不到私有实例（部署在自家数据中心）所提供的安全与隐私保证，大概不会全面押注 Claude。
2. Meta 可以像 Bedrock 那样，把 Claude 作为服务来卖。它有容量，也自 己掌握从 CPU 到 GPU 再到网络的全栈，安全性很高。但作为新进入者，要建立起 AWS 那样的全部企业客户关系并不容易。不过 Meta可以选择利用其广告主客户群，把前沿 Agent 和 LLM 更好地整合进自 己的产品套件，从而开辟一条全新的大规模分发路径。
3. Meta 还可以进一步向上垂直整合，开始做应用。作为全球最大的广告平台之一，它有条件打造一个销售与营销的重量级产品。把前沿模型和 Agent 整合进来，会提高它做出世界级方案的胜算。
There is, of course, also the opportunity to distribute models to free social media users, and to the broader Meta ecosystem including things like connected glasses. It appears more likely that they will prioritize use of their own models, but it’s good to keep the optionality, and they likely have a great path to monetization. The huge distribution potential and network effect means that the likes of OpenAI and Anthropic are likely seeing this as highly strategic, and ready to make concessions to get a piece of the pie.
当然，还有一条路：把模型分发给免费的社交媒体用户，以及分发到更广的 Meta 生态（比如智能眼镜）。看起来它们更可能优先使用 自家模型，但保留这份可选性是好事，而且变现路径大概率不错。巨大的分发潜力和网络效应意味着，OpenAI、Anthropic 这类玩家很可能把这件事看作高度战略性的机会，愿意做出让步来分一杯羹。
Scaling Ads Recommendation systems: how much can Meta accelerate?
扩展广告推荐系统：Meta 还能加速多少？

For Meta, the key AI story is how RecSys is contributing to revenue acceleration at massive scale. At the end of 2022 and early 2023, the market widely saw the company as entering a stage of maturity and low growth amongst an investment cycle. Today, it’s crystal clear that Meta has dramatically re-accelerated revenue growth, in large part due to GPU investments. They have been a key trigger, both on training and inference: RecSys models for ads have been getting bigger and more expensive to run, but much smarter, driving better yields for advertisers as seen in the ability for advertisers to pay higher prices while still seeing strong ROAS. At the same time the RecSys models for content have led to more time on platform across the Family of Apps, improving the monetizable surface area and leading to strong ad imprssions growth.
对 Meta 而言，最关键的 AI 故事是 RecSys 如何在超大规模上推动收入加速。2022 年末到 2023 年初，市场普遍认为这家公司正进入投资周期中的成熟低增长阶段。今天，事情已经再清楚不过：Meta 的收入增长大幅重新提速，很大程度上得益于 GPU 投入。GPU 在训练和推理两端都是关键触发因素：广告 RecSys 模型变得更大、运行成本更高，但也聪明得多，为广告主带来了更好的回报——表现为广告主愿意支付更高价格的同时，仍能看到强劲的广告支出回报率（ROAS）。与此同时，内容侧的 RecSys 模型拉长了整个 Family ofApps 的用户使用时长，扩大了可变现的曝光面，带来了强劲的广告展示量增长。
[Figure: More Ads AND Higher Prices — YoY growth (%) of Avg Impressions Growth and Avg Price Per Ad, 4Q23 through 1Q26. Source: SemiAnalysis Tokenomics Model]
[图：广告更多，价格更高— —平均展示量增速与单条广告平均价格的同比增速（%），4Q23 至 1Q26。来源：SemiAnalysis Tokenomics Model]
The key question on everyone’s mind is now – is this sustainable? How much can Meta accelerate core revenue growth? While Meta is playing catching up on the frontier lab side, the non-Meta SuperIntelligence AI chip fleet is producing outstanding ROI. We cover this split compute split between RecSys AI, Meta SuperIntelligence, and other Meta LLM products in our Tokenomics Model.
现在所有人心里的关键问题是— —这可持续吗？Meta 的核心收入增长还能加速多少？在前沿实验室这条线上，Meta 还在追赶，但非 Meta Superintelligence 的那部分 AI 芯片机队正在产出极其出色的投资回报。我们在 Tokenomics Model 中拆解了算力在 RecSys AI、Meta Superintelligence 与其他 Meta LLM 产品之间的分配。
Behind paywall, we discuss the outlook for RecSys scaling, and then for Meta Superintelligence Labs.
在付费墙之后，我们讨论 RecSys 扩展的前景，然后是 Meta Superintelligence Labs。
Prior to GEM, ad ranking ran on DLRMs which don’t follow the same exponential power laws seen in LLM and therefore failed to scale with compute. Meta’s generative recommender work, Hierarchical Sequential Transduction Units (HSTU), changes that by reformulating ranking as a sequential prediction problem that scales in performance with compute. It beat prior baselines by \~66% on ranking metrics and is productionized as GEM, Meta’s ads foundation model. Benefits of GEM includes:
在 GEM 之前，广告排序跑在深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）上，而 DLRM 并不遵循 LLM 身上那种指数级的幂律，因此无法随算力扩展。Meta 的生成式推荐工作 Hierarchical Sequential Transduction Units（HSTU）改变了这一点：它把排序重新表述为一个序列预测问题，性能可以随算力扩展。它在排序指标上比此前的基线高出约 66%，并已产品化为 GEM——Meta 的广告基础模型。GEM 的收益包括：

A scalable model that is 4x better at driving ad performance gains and compute efficient per unit of performance gain
一个可扩展的模型，在推动广告效果提升方面强 4 倍，且每单位效果提升所耗算力更省
A new training stack that has 23x effective training FLOPs with \~1.4x increase in MFU using 16x more GPUs
一套全新的训练栈，有效训练 FLOPs 提升 23 倍，使用 16 倍的 GPU，MFU 提升约 1.4 倍
We think Meta can profitably absorb a >10x increase in AdRec compute with this new model because each additional gigawatt correlates directly to better predictions, both on the training and inference side. This improvement is showing up through an increase in impressions delivered and average price per ad. In Q1 2026, ad impressions grew 19% YoY and average price per ad grew 12% YoY. This is a continuation CFO Susan Li has attributed their increased average price per ad to improved ad performance and targeting capabilities. After doubling GEM’s training GPUs, ad conversion rate on Instagram increased on both Instagram and Facebook by 5% and 3%, respectively.
我们认为，凭借这个新模型，Meta 可以有利可图地吸收 >10 倍的广告推荐（AdRec）算力增量，因为每增加一个 GW，都直接对应更好的预测——训练侧和推理侧都是如此。这一改进正通过广告展示量和单条广告平均价格的提升体现出来。2026 年 Q1，广告展示量同比增长 19%，单条广告平均价格同比增长 12%。这是一个延续：CFO Susan Li 一直把单条广告平均价格的上涨归因于广告效果和定向能力的改善。在把 GEM 的训练GPU 数量翻倍之后，Instagram 和 Facebook 上的广告转化率分别提升了 5% 和 3%。
What makes the growth sustainable is that the higher prices are justified because ROAS is growing directly with CPMs. Meta Advantage+ Shopping delivers 32% higher ROAS with 17% lower cost/action relative to manual campaigns. Meta can grow ad revenue in one of two ways: (1) by showing more ads, or (2) charge more per ad. But there’s a limit to how many ads it can show in a users’ feed before it does more harm to the user’s experience than good to ad revenue growth. As long as ROAS continues to grow with price, which has shown to be the case, Meta can keep lifting yield even as ad impressions growth eventually start coming up against ad-load ceiling.
增长之所以可持续，是因为更高的价格站得住脚——ROAS 正随千次展示成本（CPM）同步上升。相比手动投放的广告系列，Meta Advantage+ Shopping 的 ROAS 高出 32%，单次转化成本低 17%。Meta 提升广告收入无非两条路：（1）展示更多广告，或（2）单条广告收更高的价。但一个用户的信息流里能塞进多少广告是有上限的——超过这个上限，对用户体验的伤害就会盖过对广告收入增长的贡献。只要 ROAS 持续随价格一起增长（现实已经证明确实如此），那么即便广告展示量的增长终将撞上广告加载率的天花板，Meta 仍能继续提升单位变现效率。
Meta Superintelligence labs – another dropout, or a real threat to Anthropic and OpenAI ?
Meta 超级智能实验室——又一个半途而废者，还是 Anthropic 与OpenAI 的真正威胁？

Compute is the lifeblood of every AI research org. Anthropic would never sell compute to any of its competitors, and it’s therefore tempting to view Meta’s decision as admitting defeat for MSL.
算力是每一家 AI 研究机构的命脉。Anthropic 绝不会把算力卖给任何竞争对手，因此人们很容易把 Meta 的这个决定读成 MSL 认输。
However, we believe this framing is too simplistic. There is a world where you can temporarily sell compute to your fiercest competitors AND still become a true frontier lab. Like so much else we’ve covered in this article, Zuck really needs to thank Elon for showing him this playbook.
但我们认为这个框架过于简单。存在这样一种可能：你一边把算力临时卖给最凶狠的竞争对手，一边仍然长成一家真正的前沿实验室。就像本文中我们讲过的许多事情一样，扎克伯格真该好好谢谢马斯克，是他把这套打法演示了一遍。
We believe the following is the most likely explanation for the SpaceX/Cursor acquisition:
对于 SpaceX 收购 Cursor 一事，我们认为下面是最可能的解释：
Elon and Cursor are both still serious about building superintelligence. Cursor’s messaging over the past 6 months has changed from “we want to build the best AI coding experience” to “we want to build RSI”. This is the ethos of a frontier lab, not a wrapper startup.
SpaceX still has up to 900MW left after their eye-watering compute deals. This is sufficient for taking a few true shots on goal at reaching the frontier. Both GPT 5.6 and Fable 5 were likely trained using less compute.
The 90-day bilateral cancellation in all the SpaceX compute deals is crucial! Many were viewing this as a win for Anthropic/Google—because they can just cancel the deal if they find something cheaper—but it also means Elon can claw back all his compute if the Cursor team does well!
In other words, SpaceX/Cursor still meet the minimum requirements for training a frontier model. Over the next 6 months, we will see if they can deliver on that potential. If they do, they will claw back all their compute and continue scaling to push the frontier. If they fail, then they’ll give up for real and become a very large and profitable CSP instead. That’s certainly not a bad backup plan, and the only true cost will have been the unmonetized GPU hours spent chasing the dream of RSI.
马斯克和 Cursor 都仍然认真地想造出超级智能。过去 6 个月里，Cursor 的对外口径已经从“我们要做最好的 AI 编程体验”变成了“我们要做 RSI（递归自我改进）”。这是前沿实验室的信条，不是套壳创业公司的。
在那些令人咋舌的算力交易之后，SpaceX 手上仍留有多达 900MW。这足够它对着前沿真正射门几次了。GPT 5.6 和 Fable 5 用掉的算力很可能都比这更少。
SpaceX 所有算力交易里的 90 天双向取消条款至关重要！很多人把它看作 Anthropic/Google 的胜利—因为一旦找到更便宜的选项就可以直接毁约——但它同样意味着：只要 Cursor 团队做得好，马斯克可以随时把算力全部收回！
换句话说，SpaceX/Cursor 仍然满足训练一个前沿模型的最低门槛。未来 6 个月，我们就能看到它们能否兑现这份潜力。如果能，它们会把算力全部收回，继续扩展、冲击前沿。如果不能，那它们就是真的放弃了，转而成为一家规模巨大且盈利丰厚的云服务商（CSP）。这当然算不上一个糟糕的备胎方案，唯一的真实代价，不过是追逐 RSI 之梦时那些未被变现的 GPU 工时。

A future post will cover all of this in more detail, but we think Meta is taking the same approach with MSL. The only difference is that they have even more options to monetize the excess compute in the meantime! RecSys and TaaS compute can essentially be repurposed back to research at any time.
后续的文章会更详细地讲这一切，但我们认为 Meta 在 MSL 上采取的是同一套打法。唯一的差别是，在此期间它们有更多把过剩算力变现的选项！RecSys 和 TaaS 占用的算力，本质上可以随时被调回研究用途。
Compute, data, and talent are the three pillars of a frontier lab, and unlike the other hyperscalers, Zuck has put up the capital to try becoming world-class at all three. Success is far from guaranteed, but it’d be a mistake to count them out. The one thing that’d change our minds is if they sign a compute deal without any sort of SpaceX-style early cancellation clause. If that happens, then MSL is actually cooked.
算力、数据、人才，是一家前沿实验室的三根支柱；与其他 hyperscaler 不同，扎克伯格已经砸下资本，要在这三项上都做到世界一流。成功远未有保证，但把他们提前出局是个错误。唯一能让我们改变看法的信号是：它们签下一笔完全没有 SpaceX 式提前取消条款的算力合约。真要是那样，MSL 就是真的凉了。
